title: -스럽다·-롭다·-답다: 느낌을 말하는 낱말
objective: By the end, you can understand and use ten common -스럽다, -롭다 and -답다 adjectives, including their -아요/어요 forms and the forms that come before a noun.
summary: Learn ten everyday adjectives made with -스럽다, -롭다 and -답다, and how to use them in short sentences.

task.title: Use the new adjectives
task.line: Read each item, then choose or write the adjective in the right form (remember that ㅂ changes to 우 or 워).

words.exampleMeaning: Your Korean pronunciation has become much more natural.
My niece looks so adorable when she smiles.

words.example: 아이가 밥을 잘 안 먹어서 걱정스러워요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm worried because my child isn't eating well.

words.meaning: too much, making you feel uncomfortable or pressured
words.example: 처음 만난 사이에 비싼 선물은 좀 부담스러워요.
words.exampleMeaning: An expensive gift from someone I just met feels like a bit much.
At our company, work hours are flexible.
The park was quiet and peaceful on the weekend morning.

words.example: 이사 온 지 얼마 안 돼서 모든 게 새로워요.
words.exampleMeaning: I just moved here, so everything feels new.

words.example: 일이 일찍 끝나서 오늘 저녁은 여유로워요.
words.exampleMeaning: Work ended early, so I have a relaxed evening today.
That singer has a really beautiful voice.

words.meaning: befitting a student, like a (good) student
words.example: 민수 씨는 학생답게 항상 단정하게 입어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Minsu dresses neatly at all times, as a student should.

exercises: Make a new adjective with -스럽다 or -롭다 (-롭다 comes after a vowel, -스럽다 usually after a consonant): ① 지혜 ② 자랑
Choose the right word: ① 그 배우는 외국 사람인데 한국말이 아주 (자연스러워요 / 사랑스러워요). ② 강아지가 꼬리를 흔드는 모습이 너무 (평화로워요 / 사랑스러워요).
Choose the best word for each situation from 걱정스럽다, 부담스럽다, 여유롭다, 새롭다: ① 친구가 사흘째 열이 나요. ② 동료가 너무 비싼 생일 선물을 줬어요. ③ 일요일 오후에 할 일이 없어서 천천히 차를 마셔요. ④ 회사를 옮겨서 모든 게 처음이에요.
Fill in the blank with 자유롭다 in the -아서/어서 form: 방학에는 시간이 ____ 여행을 많이 다녀요.
Change the word in brackets so it can come before the noun: ① (아름답다) 노래 ② (평화롭다) 마을
Fill in the blank with 학생답다 in the -게 form: 시험 기간에는 ____ 열심히 공부해요.
answers: ① 걱정스럽다 ② 부담스럽다 ③ 여유롭다 ④ 새롭다
